hero.headline: Your Payment Gateway.
hero.subheadline: GetBlitz is an open-source SEPA Instant Transfer gateway that runs on your infrastructure — zero middlemen, zero tracking, zero lock-in. Built for European businesses that value sovereignty.

problem.headline: The American Tax on European Payments
problem.subheadline: Stripe, PayPal, and Square are American companies operating under US law — and you're paying for it every day.

features.headline: Everything You Need,
features.subheadline: A focused feature set built for European businesses that need real payment infrastructure — not a bloated SaaS platform.

items.title: SEPA Instant Transfers
items.description: Accept real-time EUR bank transfers across all 36 SEPA countries — funds settle in under 10 seconds, directly to your bank account.

items.title: Real-Time WebSocket Notifications
items.description: Know the moment a payment lands. GetBlitz uses Socket.io to push live payment events to your app — no polling, no delays.

items.title: Full Data Sovereignty
items.description: Your database. Your server. Your rules. No third party ever touches your transaction data or customer information.

items.title: Multi-Tenant Architecture
items.description: Manage multiple organizations, bank accounts, and API keys from a single dashboard — ideal for agencies, SaaS platforms, and marketplace operators.

items.title: Embeddable JavaScript SDK
items.description: Drop a single script tag into any website. The lightweight GetBlitz widget handles the payment UI, QR code display, and real-time status updates automatically.

items.title: Built-In Test Mode
items.description: A mock bank simulator is included out of the box so you can develop and test your integration without touching real money.

items.title: Enterprise-Grade Security
items.description: HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification, rotatable API keys, configurable Redis-backed rate limiting, strict CORS enforcement, and ACID-compliant database transactions.

items.title: Webhook Events
items.description: Receive payment.success, payment.partial, payment.failed, and payment.expired events with full payload details — integrate with any backend.

items.title: Pluggable Bank Providers
items.description: Connect your Qonto or Revolut business account today, or implement a custom provider using the open BankProvider interface.

items.title: Smart Invoice Management
items.description: Generate, send, and track professional invoices directly from the dashboard. Automatically reconcile incoming SEPA transfers with open invoices by matching payment references.

items.title: Built-in Customer Directory
items.description: Keep all your customer details and payment histories in one secure, GDPR-compliant place. Easily associate transactions and invoices with specific clients.

items.title: 36 SEPA Countries
items.description: From Lisbon to Tallinn, any business bank account in the SEPA zone can receive instant EUR transfers. True pan-European payment coverage.

steps.title: Session Created
steps.description: Call the API and GetBlitz returns a secure payment URL and session ID.

steps.title: Customer Scans QR
steps.description: Display the payment page and the customer scans the code with their banking app.

steps.title: Instant SEPA Webhook
steps.description: Customer completes the transfer and the bank instantly sends a webhook to GetBlitz.

steps.title: Real-Time Callback
steps.description: Your app receives the onSuccess callback via WebSockets — payment complete!

banks.headline: Connect Your European
banks.subheadline: GetBlitz connects directly to your bank account. No money transmitter in the middle — funds flow straight to you.
banks.extensibility: Don't see your bank? Implement our open BankProvider interface in TypeScript and submit a PR.

items.title: GDPR-native by design
items.description: When you self-host GetBlitz, your transaction data never leaves your jurisdiction. No data processing agreements to negotiate with a US company.

items.title: No surveillance capitalism
items.description: GetBlitz has no analytics, no telemetry, no third-party trackers. It's your software, running on your terms.

items.title: Open Source, MIT Licensed
items.description: Audit every line. Fork it. Modify it. You're never at the mercy of a pricing change or a product sunset.

items.title: Direct bank relationships
items.description: You connect directly to your bank. GetBlitz is middleware, not a money transmitter. Funds flow straight to your account.

items.title: 36 SEPA countries
items.description: From Lisbon to Tallinn, any business bank account in the SEPA zone can receive instant EUR transfers.

items.title: Developer-First API
items.description: Built on open standards with modern webhooks, real-time SDKs, and a clean architecture.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At GetBlitz, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy details how we handle information when you visit our website. As an open-source, self-hosted product, GetBlitz is designed to ensure maximum data sovereignty.

sections.title: 1. Information We Do Not Collect
sections.content: When you use the self-hosted version of GetBlitz, we do not have access to any of your financial data, transaction records, bank details, or customer information. Your data remains entirely on your servers and within your chosen infrastructure.

sections.title: 2. Website Analytics and Cookies
sections.content: Our website (getblitz.com) uses essential cookies only to function correctly and prevent fraud. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party behavioral analytics tools that compromise your privacy.

sections.title: 3. Third-Party Links
